items.title: Computable many one reducibility interface

portal.statement:
For $A,B\subseteq\mathbb N$, write $A\le_m B$ if a total computable $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ satisfies
$$\forall n\in\mathbb N\quad(n\in A\ \Longleftrightarrow\ f(n)\in B).$$
portal.locator: Shared Math Library, def-computable-many-one-reducibility-interface, Definition (ordinary many-one reducibility on natural numbers)

items.title: Computably enumerable sets and languages

portal.statement:
Fix an effectively encoded set $X$.

A subset $A\subseteq X$ is **computably enumerable** when either $A=\varnothing$
or there exists a total computable function
$$ e:\mathbb N\to X $$
whose range is exactly $A$.

If $L\subseteq\Sigma^*$ is a language over an alphabet $\Sigma$, then $L$ is
**computably enumerable** when it is c.e. as a subset of $\Sigma^*$ under the
chosen effective word encoding.

items.title: Infinite computably enumerable sets have computable injective enumerations

portal.statement:
Every infinite computably enumerable subset of an effectively encoded set $X$ is
the range of a total computable injective function $\mathbb N\to X$.

items.title: The classes $\Sigma_n^0$, $\Pi_n^0$, and $\Delta_n^0$

portal.statement:
For $n\ge1$, a set $A\subseteq\mathbb N^k$ is **$\Sigma_n^0$** when, for a
primitive-recursive predicate $R$, membership has a formula
$$ \vec x\in A\iff \exists y_1\forall y_2\cdots Qy_n\ R(\vec x,\vec y), $$
where the quantifiers alternate and $Q$ is existential for odd $n$. It is
**$\Pi_n^0$** when its complement is $\Sigma_n^0$, equivalently when the
display begins universally. Put
$$ \Delta_n^0:=\Sigma_n^0\cap\Pi_n^0. $$

Bounded quantifiers in $R$ are allowed under the convention of
[[def-bounded-arithmetic-formula]].

items.title: Relative computability and relative enumerability

portal.statement:
Fix the canonical binary numeral for each natural number (with zero encoded
as $0$). For an oracle $X\subseteq\mathbb N$, an oracle program is a finite
deterministic machine program with ordinary transitions as in
[[def-one-step-configuration-relation]], together with query instructions.
A query instruction reads a finite binary numeral $q$ delimited on the tape
and selects one of two specified successor states according as $q\in X$ or
$q\notin X$; it leaves the tape and head unchanged. Malformed queries select
the negative successor. On input $n$, start in the initial state with its
numeral at the left end of an otherwise blank tape and the head at position
zero. Iterate these transitions until an accepting or rejecting state is
entered, if that ever happens.

A set $A\subseteq\mathbb N$ is **$X$-computable** when some such program
halts on every numeral input and accepts exactly the members of $A$.
It is **$X$-c.e.** when some such program accepts exactly the members of $A$;
on nonmembers it may reject or run forever. Write $A\le_T X$ for
$X$-computability. A function $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ is **total
$X$-computable** when some such oracle program halts on every numeral input
$n$ with the numeral of $f(n)$ as its delimited output.

An oracle program still makes finitely many transitions on any halting run;
it does not read an infinite oracle at once.

items.title: Universal and acceptable numberings

portal.statement:
Let $(\varphi_e)_{e\in\mathbb N}$ be a numbering of the partial computable
functions.

The numbering is **universal** when the binary partial function
$$ U(e,x)\simeq\varphi_e(x) $$
is itself partial computable.

The numbering is **acceptable** when it is universal and there exists a total
computable function
$$ s:\mathbb N^2\to\mathbb N $$
such that for all $e,a,x\in\mathbb N$ one has
$$ \varphi_{s(e,a)}(x)\simeq\varphi_e(\ulcorner a,x\urcorner_{\mathrm{seq}}), $$
where $\ulcorner a,x\urcorner_{\mathrm{seq}}$ is the chosen code of the
two-term sequence $(a,x)$.

items.title: The halting set is $\Sigma_1^0$-complete

portal.statement:
For a fixed acceptable numbering, $K=\{\langle e,x\rangle:\varphi_e(x)\downarrow\}$
is $\Sigma_1^0$-complete.

items.title: One-one, finite-one, and many-one reducibility

article.statement:
Finite-one reducibility is the restriction of many-one reducibility in which every fibre of the reducing function is finite. Thus, for all sets $X,Y$,

$$X\leq_1 Y \Longrightarrow X\leq_{\mathrm{fo}}Y\ \Longrightarrow X\leq_{\mathrm{m}}Y.$$
article.locator: §1, p. 1 (unnumbered)

items.title: Infinite antichains in many-one degrees of m-rigid sets

article.statement:
Earlier work established that, for almost every $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ with respect to the standard product measure on $2^\mathbb{N}$, the degree $[A]_{\mathrm{m}}$ contains an infinite antichain of finite-one degrees [1].

Earlier work established that the many-one degree of every $m$-rigid set contains an infinite antichain of finite-one degrees [1]. Since the class of $m$-rigid sets has Lebesgue measure $1$ and is comeager, this gave an almost-sure and comeager negative answer to the question.
article.locator: Abstract and §1, p. 1 (prior result [1])

items.title: The cylinder gives the greatest finite-one degree

article.statement:
For every set $A$, the cylinder

$$\operatorname{Cyl}(A)=\{\langle x,n\rangle:x\in A, n\in\mathbb{N}\}$$

belongs to the same many-one degree as $A$, and $[\operatorname{Cyl}(A)]_{\mathrm{fo}}$ is the greatest finite-one degree in that many-one degree.
article.locator: §1, p. 1 (unnumbered). See also §2, pp. 2–3, for the pairing and degree conventions.

items.title: Dichotomy for a nonrecursive degree with a co-c.e. representative

article.statement: Maslova proved that every nonrecursive computably enumerable (c.e.) many-one degree contains either exactly one or infinitely many finite-one degrees [2]. We shall also use the same conclusion when the complement of a representative is c.e., by passing to the complementary many-one degree and using complementation.
article.locator: §1, p. 1 (unnumbered); applied in the proof of Corollary 7, p. 14

items.title: Profile realization

article.statement:
If $p:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ is total computable, define its infinite-fibre profile by

$$I_p=\{y:|p^{-1}(y)|=\infty\}.$$

A section of a map $p:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ is a map $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that

$$p(s(y))=y \qquad\text{for every }y\in\mathbb{N}.$$

Thus a section is a right inverse of $p$.

For every $P\in\Pi^0_2$ there is a total computable surjection $p:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that

$$I_p=P.$$

Moreover, $p$ has a computable section.
article.locator: §2, Lemma 1, p. 3

items.title: Descending uniformly c.e. presentation of the profile

article.statement:
Choose a computable predicate $Q$ such that

$$y\in P \iff \forall j\,\exists s\,Q(y,j,s).$$

For each $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let

$$H_k= \{y:\forall j<k\,\exists s\,Q(y,j,s)\}.$$

The sequence $(H_k)_{k\in\mathbb{N}}$ is uniformly c.e., and

$$\mathbb{N}=H_0\supseteq H_1\supseteq H_2\supseteq\cdots.$$

Moreover,

$$P=\bigcap_{k\in\mathbb{N}}H_k.$$
article.locator: §2, proof of Lemma 1, p. 3 (unnumbered, under the Π⁰₂ hypothesis of Lemma 1)

items.title: Computable injective section of a computable surjection

article.statement:
Finally, define

$$s(y)=\mu n\,[p(n)=y].$$

The function $s$ is total computable because $p$ is computable and surjective, and

$$p(s(y))=y$$

for every $y$. Thus $s$ is a computable section of $p$.

Moreover, if $s(y)=s(z)$, then

$$y=p(s(y))=p(s(z))=z.$$

Thus $s$ is injective.
article.locator: §2, proof of Lemma 1, p. 4 (unnumbered)

items.title: Finite-marker avoidance

article.statement:
A uniformly c.e. family $(V_x)_{x\in\mathbb{N}}$ is called $A$-homogeneous if

$$z\in V_x \Longrightarrow A(z)=A(x).$$

Assume that $A$ is not a cylinder and that neither $A$ nor $\overline A$ is c.e. If $(V_x)_{x\in\mathbb{N}}$ is a uniformly c.e. $A$-homogeneous family, then for every finite $Z\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ there is $x$ such that

$$V_x \text{ is finite} \qquad\text{and}\qquad V_x\cap Z=\varnothing.$$
article.locator: §3, Lemma 2, p. 4

items.title: Infinite homogeneous rows give a one-one reduction from the cylinder

article.statement:
We first record a general observation that will be used twice in the proof. Suppose that $(W_x)_{x\in\mathbb{N}}$ is a uniformly c.e. $A$-homogeneous family and that every $W_x$ is infinite.

Fix a computable enumeration without repetitions

$$(x_0,n_0),(x_1,n_1),\ldots$$

of $\mathbb{N}^2$. We construct a function

$$G:\mathbb{N}^2\to\mathbb{N}$$

recursively along this enumeration. When treating $(x_i,n_i)$, wait for an element of $W_{x_i}$ which has not been used at any earlier step, and define $G(x_i,n_i)$ to be the first such element found.

Since $W_{x_i}$ is infinite and only finitely many values have been used before step $i$, this search terminates. Thus $G$ is a total computable injection satisfying

$$G(x,n)\in W_x$$

for all $x,n$. By the $A$-homogeneity of $(W_x)_{x\in\mathbb{N}}$,

$$A(G(x,n))=A(x).$$

Consequently, the map

$$\langle x,n\rangle\longmapsto G(x,n)$$

witnesses

$$\operatorname{Cyl}(A)\leq_1 A.$$
article.locator: §3, general observation in the proof of Lemma 2, pp. 4–5 (unnumbered)

items.title: Cofinite-domain lemma

article.statement:
A partial computable function $\varphi$ is a partial ascending self-reduction of $A$ if, for every $x\in\operatorname{dom}\varphi$,

$$\varphi(x)>x \qquad\text{and}\qquad A(\varphi(x))=A(x).$$

Assume that $A$ is nonrecursive and is not a cylinder. If $\varphi$ is a partial ascending self-reduction of $A$, then

$$\mathbb{N}\setminus\operatorname{dom}\varphi$$

is infinite.
article.locator: §3, Lemma 4, p. 6 (partial ascending self-reduction convention in Definition 3, p. 6)

items.title: Local interpolation

article.statement:
Assume that $A$ is nonrecursive, is not a cylinder, and neither $A$ nor $\overline A$ is c.e. Then there is a set $C\equiv_{\mathrm{m}} A$ such that

$$[A]_{\mathrm{fo}}<[C]_{\mathrm{fo}}<[\operatorname{Cyl}(A)]_{\mathrm{fo}}.$$
article.locator: §4, Theorem 5, p. 8

items.title: A set c.e. in the halting problem meeting the upper and lower requirements

article.statement:
Assume that $A$ is nonrecursive, is not a cylinder, and neither $A$ nor $\overline A$ is c.e.

Fix an effective enumeration

$$\bigl((V_x^e)_{x\in\mathbb{N}}\bigr)_{e\in\mathbb{N}}$$

of all uniformly c.e. families, and an effective enumeration $(\varphi_e)_{e\in\mathbb{N}}$ of all partial computable functions.

Fix standard finite stage approximations

$$V^e_{x,0}\subseteq V^e_{x,1}\subseteq\cdots, \qquad V_x^e=\bigcup_s V^e_{x,s},$$

uniformly computable in $e,x,s$.

We construct a set $N$ which is c.e. in $0'$, satisfying the requirements

$$\mathcal U_e:\quad (V_x^e)_x\text{ is $A$-homogeneous} \Longrightarrow \exists x\, [V_x^e\text{ finite and }V_x^e\subseteq N],$$

and

$$\mathcal L_e:\quad \varphi_e\text{ is a partial ascending self-reduction of }A \Longrightarrow \exists m\, [m\notin N\cup\operatorname{dom}\varphi_e].$$

Use the priority ordering

$$\mathcal U_0>\mathcal L_0> \mathcal U_1>\mathcal L_1>\cdots.$$

The construction does not attempt to decide whether either antecedent in the requirements holds. Its actions are independent of $A$. The hypotheses involving $A$ are used only in the verification: Lemma 2 is used to verify the $\mathcal U_e$-requirements, while Lemma 4 is used to verify the $\mathcal L_e$-requirements.

Therefore every $\mathcal U_e$ is satisfied.

At each stage only finitely many requirements are visited, each strategy performs only finitely many $0'$-decidable tests, and only a finite set is enumerated into $N$. Thus the enumeration of $N$ is computable in $0'$.

Let

$$P=\mathbb{N}\setminus N.$$

Since $N$ is c.e. in $0'$, we have $N\in\Sigma^0_2$. Therefore $P=\mathbb N\setminus N$ belongs to $\Pi^0_2$.
article.locator: §4, proof of Theorem 5, pp. 8–10 (requirements on p. 8 and verification on pp. 9–10)

items.title: The halting problem decides row stability at a fixed stage

article.statement:
Let $Z_e$ be the finite set of markers currently carried by higher-priority $\mathcal L$-requirements. If $\mathcal U_e$ has not yet acted, search among pairs $x,t\leq s$ for one such that

$$V^e_{x,t}\cap Z_e=\varnothing, \qquad V^e_{x,t}\subseteq\{0,\ldots,s\},$$

and

$$\forall r\geq t\, [V^e_{x,r}=V^e_{x,t}].$$

The last condition is decidable in $0'$. Indeed, for fixed $e,x,t$, failure of the stability condition is the $\Sigma^0_1$ statement

$$\exists r\geq t\, [V^e_{x,r}\neq V^e_{x,t}].$$

Hence $0'$ decides whether the row receives any new element after the specified stage $t$. Notice that this does not amount to deciding, with $0'$, whether an arbitrary c.e. row is finite.
article.locator: §4, proof of Theorem 5, p. 8, Strategy for the upper requirement (unnumbered)

items.title: Finite injury and stabilization of marker restraints

article.statement:
Observe that an active marker carried by an $\mathcal L_e$-strategy can be injured only by a higher-priority $\mathcal U$-strategy. Indeed, a lower-priority $\mathcal U$-strategy either had already acted when the marker was chosen, in which case its stabilized row was already contained in $N$ and hence could not contain the marker, or had not yet acted, in which case, as long as the marker remains active, it includes the marker among its restraints and therefore must choose a row disjoint from it.

By definition, once the $\mathcal U_i$-strategy acts, it declares $\mathcal U_i$ permanently satisfied and is never eligible to act again. Indeed, its chosen stabilized row is then entirely contained in $N$.

Thus every $\mathcal U_i$ acts at most once. Hence, for every $e$, there is a stage $s_e$ after which no $\mathcal U_i$ of higher priority than $\mathcal L_e$ acts. By the preceding observation, $\mathcal L_e$ cannot be injured after stage $s_e$.

If $\mathcal L_e$ carries a marker at the end of stage $s_e$, that marker is final. Otherwise, either it chooses a marker at some later visit, in which case that marker is final, or it remains permanently markerless. Thus every $\mathcal L_e$ eventually reaches a final state. Consequently, for every fixed requirement, the finite set of active markers carried by higher-priority $\mathcal L$-strategies eventually stabilizes.
article.locator: §4, proof of Theorem 5, p. 9, Verification (unnumbered)

items.title: Many-one equivalence and one-one reduction for the pullback

article.statement:
By Lemma 1, fix a total computable surjection $p$ with computable section such that

$$I_p=P,$$

and put

$$C=p^{-1}(A).$$

Let $s$ be a computable section of $p$. For every $y\in\mathbb{N}$,

$$y\in A \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad p(s(y))\in A \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad s(y)\in C.$$

Since $s$ is injective, it witnesses

$$A\leq_1 C,$$

and hence

$$A\leq_{\mathrm{fo}}C.$$

On the other hand, for every $u\in\mathbb{N}$,

$$u\in C \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad p(u)\in A,$$

so $p$ witnesses

$$C\leq_{\mathrm{m}}A.$$

Since $A\leq_1C$ implies $A\leq_{\mathrm{m}}C$, it follows that

$$C\equiv_{\mathrm{m}}A.$$
article.locator: §4, proof of Theorem 5, p. 11 (unnumbered)

items.title: Homogeneous rows from a reduction of the cylinder

article.statement:
By Lemma 1, fix a total computable surjection $p$ with computable section such that

$$I_p=P,$$

and put

$$C=p^{-1}(A).$$

Suppose conversely that

$$h:\operatorname{Cyl}(A)\leq_{\mathrm{fo}} C.$$

For each $x$, define

$$V_x=\{p(h(\langle x,n\rangle)):n\in\mathbb{N}\}.$$

Although $p$ was chosen only after the construction of $N$, there is no circularity here. Once $p$ and the hypothetical reduction $h$ are fixed, $(V_x)_{x\in\mathbb{N}}$ is an ordinary uniformly c.e. family. Consequently, there is an index $e$ such that

$$V_x=V_x^e \qquad\text{for every }x.$$

This family is $A$-homogeneous. Indeed, if

$$y=p(h(\langle x,n\rangle)),$$

then

$$y\in A \iff h(\langle x,n\rangle)\in C \iff \langle x,n\rangle\in\operatorname{Cyl}(A) \iff x\in A.$$
article.locator: §4, proof of Theorem 5, p. 11 (unnumbered); C and p are defined earlier on p. 11

items.title: Ascending self-reduction from a finite-one reduction of the pullback

article.statement:
By Lemma 1, fix a total computable surjection $p$ with computable section such that

$$I_p=P,$$

and put

$$C=p^{-1}(A).$$

Suppose, toward a contradiction, that

$$h:C\leq_{\mathrm{fo}}A.$$

Define the partial computable function $f_h$ by

$$f_h(y)=h(u),$$

where $u$ is the least number such that

$$p(u)=y \qquad\text{and}\qquad h(u)>y.$$

Whenever $f_h(y)$ is defined,

$$f_h(y)>y$$

and, because $h$ is a reduction,

$$A(f_h(y)) =A(h(u)) =A(p(u)) =A(y).$$

Thus $f_h$ is a partial ascending self-reduction of $A$.

If $y\in P$, then $p^{-1}(y)$ is infinite. Since $h$ is finite-one,

$$h^{-1}(\{0,\ldots,y\}) = \bigcup_{z\leq y}h^{-1}(z)$$

is finite. Hence some $u\in p^{-1}(y)$ satisfies $h(u)>y$, and so

$$P\subseteq\operatorname{dom} f_h.$$
article.locator: §4, proof of Theorem 5, pp. 11–12 (p. 11 defines p and C, p. 12 states the result)

items.title: Effectiveness of the priority construction

article.statement:
Several points concerning the effectiveness of the construction are worth emphasizing.

First, for a partial computable function $\varphi_e$, the condition

$$m\notin\operatorname{dom}\varphi_e$$

is decidable in $0'$. Thus an $\mathcal L_e$-strategy can choose a marker with permanent certification that it lies outside $\operatorname{dom}\varphi_e$.

Second, a $\mathcal U$-requirement acting at stage $s$ enumerates into $N$ only numbers at most $s$. Consequently, no action before stage $m$ can enumerate $m$ into $N$. Once the higher-priority $\mathcal U$-requirements have ceased acting, a newly chosen marker is also protected from every lower-priority $\mathcal U$-requirement. One which has already acted selected a row already contained in $N$; since the marker is chosen outside the current content of $N$, that row cannot contain it. One which has not yet acted includes the marker among its restraints and therefore selects a row disjoint from it.

Finally, the finite parameters hardcoded in the proofs of Lemmas 2 and 4 need not be recovered by the priority construction. For a $\mathcal U_e$-requirement, the current finite restraint set $Z_e$ is explicitly available at every stage. Once it stabilizes, Lemma 2 guarantees the existence of a finite row disjoint from it, and the bounded $0'$-search eventually finds a stabilization pair $(x,t)$ without having to recognize that the restraints have stabilized. For an $\mathcal L_e$-requirement, Lemma 4 is used only to guarantee arbitrarily large elements of

$$\mathbb{N}\setminus\operatorname{dom}\varphi_e,$$

while each individual candidate is checked by the $0'$-test described above. Thus the two lemmas are used only existentially in the verification, and no uniform computation of the finite parameters appearing in their proofs is required.
article.locator: §4, Remark 6, p. 13

items.title: Maslova's dichotomy for nonrecursive c.e. many-one degrees

article.statement: We use the following consequence of Maslova's theorem [2], in the formulation recorded by Richter, Stephan, and Zhang [6, p. 17]: every nonrecursive c.e. many-one degree contains either exactly one or infinitely many finite-one degrees.
article.locator: §5, p. 13 (unnumbered, consequence of [2] as stated in [6, p. 17]); also §1, p. 1

items.title: Dichotomy for nonrecursive many-one degrees

article.statement: Every nonrecursive many-one degree contains either exactly one or infinitely many finite-one degrees. In particular, there is no nonrecursive many-one degree containing at least two but only finitely many finite-one degrees.
article.locator: §5, Corollary 7, p. 13

items.title: Complementation induces an order isomorphism

article.statement:
For a many-one degree $\mathbf d$, let

$$\mathcal F(\mathbf d) = \{[X]_{\mathrm{fo}}:X\in\mathbf d\}.$$

Suppose next that $\overline A$ is c.e. Put

$$\mathbf d^{\,c}=[\overline A]_{\mathrm{m}}.$$

Complementation induces an order isomorphism

$$\Phi:\mathcal F(\mathbf d)\longrightarrow \mathcal F(\mathbf d^{\,c})$$

given by

$$\Phi([X]_{\mathrm{fo}})=[\overline X]_{\mathrm{fo}}.$$

Indeed, for every total computable function $f$,

$$f:X\leq_{\mathrm{m}}Y \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad f:\overline X\leq_{\mathrm{m}}\overline Y,$$

and, since the fibres of $f$ are unchanged,

$$f:X\leq_{\mathrm{fo}}Y \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad f:\overline X\leq_{\mathrm{fo}}\overline Y.$$

Thus $\Phi$ is well defined and order preserving. The same complementation map, now considered from $\mathcal F(\mathbf d^{\,c})$ to $\mathcal F(\mathbf d)$, is the inverse of $\Phi$. Hence $\Phi$ is an order isomorphism.
article.locator: §5, proof of Corollary 7, pp. 13–14 (notation on p. 13, isomorphism on p. 14)

fun X =>
  let Program (states symbols : Nat) :=
    Fin (states + 3) →
      Sum (Fin (symbols + 4) → Fin (states + 3) × Fin (symbols + 4) × Bool)
        (Fin (states + 3) × Fin (states + 3))
  let Configuration (states symbols : Nat) :=
    Fin (states + 3) × Nat × List (Fin (symbols + 4))
  let numeral (symbols n : Nat) : List (Fin (symbols + 4)) :=
    List.map (fun digit => if digit = '0' then 0 else 1) (Nat.toDigits 2 n)
  let readNumeral (symbols : Nat) (tape : List (Fin (symbols + 4))) (start : Nat) :
      Option Nat :=
    let tail := List.drop start tape
    let word := List.takeWhile (fun digit => digit != 3) tail
    let n := List.foldl (fun acc digit => 2 * acc + Fin.val digit) 0 word
    if List.getD tail (List.length word) 2 = 3 ∧ word = numeral symbols n then
      Option.some n
    else
      Option.none
  let halting (states : Nat) (state : Fin (states + 3)) : Bool :=
    state == 1 || state == 2
  let step (states symbols : Nat) (program : Program states symbols)
      (config nextConfig : Configuration states symbols) : Prop :=
    let (state, head, tape) := config
    halting states state = false ∧
      match program state with
      | Sum.inl ordinary =>
        let (next, symbol, right) := ordinary (List.getD tape head 2)
        let padded := tape ++ List.replicate (head + 1 - List.length tape) 2
        nextConfig = (next, if right then head + 1 else head - 1, List.set padded head symbol)
      | Sum.inr (yes, no) =>
        match readNumeral symbols tape head with
        | Option.none => nextConfig = (no, head, tape)
        | Option.some q =>
          (q ∈ X ∧ nextConfig = (yes, head, tape)) ∨
          (q ∉ X ∧ nextConfig = (no, head, tape))
  let haltsWith (states symbols : Nat) (program : Program states symbols) (input : Nat)
      (post : Fin (states + 3) → List (Fin (symbols + 4)) → Prop) : Prop :=
    ∃ (state : Fin (states + 3)) (head : Nat) (tape : List (Fin (symbols + 4))),
      Relation.ReflTransGen (step states symbols program)
        (0, 0, numeral symbols input) (state, head, tape) ∧
      halting states state = true ∧ post state tape
  ( (fun A =>
      ∃ (states symbols : Nat) (program : Program states symbols),
        ∀ n : Nat, haltsWith states symbols program n (fun _ _ => True) ∧
          (haltsWith states symbols program n (fun state _ => state = 1) ↔ n ∈ A)),
    (fun A =>
      ∃ (states symbols : Nat) (program : Program states symbols),
        ∀ n : Nat, haltsWith states symbols program n (fun state _ => state = 1) ↔ n ∈ A),
    (fun f =>
      ∃ (states symbols : Nat) (program : Program states symbols),
        ∀ n : Nat, haltsWith states symbols program n
          (fun _ tape => readNumeral symbols tape 0 = Option.some (f n))) )

def agrees (X : Set Nat) (w : List Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ i b, w[i]? = some b → (b = true ↔ i ∈ X)

def tracks {α β : Type} (X : Set Nat) (F : List Bool × α →. β) (f : α →. β) : Prop :=
  (∀ {w a b}, agrees X w → b ∈ F (w, a) → b ∈ f a) ∧
  (∀ {a b}, b ∈ f a → ∃ k : Nat, ∀ w : List Bool,
    agrees X w → k ≤ w.length → b ∈ F (w, a))

theorem tracks_ignore {α β : Type} (X : Set Nat) (f : α →. β) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => f p.2) f :=
  ⟨fun _ h => h, fun h => ⟨0, fun _ _ _ => h⟩⟩

theorem tracks_input {α β γ : Type} {X : Set Nat} {F : List Bool × β →. γ}
    {f : β →. γ} (h : tracks X F f) (g : α → β) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => F (p.1, g p.2)) (fun a => f (g a)) :=
  ⟨fun hw hm => h.1 hw hm, fun hm => h.2 hm⟩

theorem tracks_map {α β γ : Type} {X : Set Nat} {F : List Bool × α →. β}
    {f : α →. β} (h : tracks X F f) (g : α → β → γ) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => (F p).map (g p.2))
      (fun a => (f a).map (g a)) := by

  · intro w a c hw hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := (Part.mem_map_iff _).mp hc

    {G : List Bool × (α × β) →. γ} {f : α →. β} {g : α × β →. γ}
    (hf : tracks X F f) (hg : tracks X G g) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => (F p).bind fun b => G (p.1, p.2, b))
      (fun a => (f a).bind fun b => g (a, b)) := by

    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp hc

theorem tracks_prec {X : Set Nat} {G : List Bool × Nat →. Nat}

      let (a, n) := p.2.unpair

        let (a, n) := p.unpair
        n.rec (g a) fun y ih => ih.bind fun b => h (a.pair (y.pair b))) := by

        n.rec (G (p.1, a)) fun y ih => ih.bind fun b => H (p.1, a.pair (y.pair b)))
        (fun _ => n.rec (g a) fun y ih => ih.bind fun b => h (a.pair (y.pair b))) := by

    | zero => exact tracks_input hg (fun _ : Unit => a)
    | succ n ih =>
      exact tracks_bind ih (tracks_input hh (fun p : Unit × Nat => a.pair (n.pair p.2)))

    rw [hp] at hb ⊢

    rcases hp : p.unpair with ⟨a, n⟩
    dsimp only at hb

    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hc (a := ()) hb

  | comp hf hg ihf ihg =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, htF⟩ := ihf
    obtain ⟨G, hG, htG⟩ := ihg
    exact ⟨_, hG.bind (hF.comp ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst).pair Computable.snd)).to₂,
      tracks_bind htG (tracks_input htF Prod.snd)⟩
  | prec hf hg ihf ihg =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, htF⟩ := ihf
    obtain ⟨G, hG, htG⟩ := ihg

      (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst).pair
        (hp.comp (Computable.fst.comp (hc.comp Computable.fst)) (hp.comp Computable.fst Computable.snd |>.comp Computable.snd))
    refine ⟨_, ?_, tracks_prec htF htG⟩
    exact (Partrec.nat_rec (Computable.snd.comp hc)
      (hF.comp (Computable.fst.pair (Computable.fst.comp hc))) (hG.comp step).to₂).of_eq

    obtain ⟨F, hF, htF⟩ := ih

      (fun v => decide (v = 0))

inductive Control | advance | query | answer (b : Bool) | store (b : Bool)

abbrev Label (Q : Type) := Q ⊕ Control

def extend {Q : Type} (M : Machine Q Work) : Machine (Label Q) Work where
  initial := .inl M.initial
  transition
    | .inl q, a => (M.transition q a).map fun cmd => ⟨.inl cmd.state, cmd.write, cmd.move⟩
    | .inr _, _ => none

def liftCfg {Q : Type} (c : OneSided.Cfg Work Q) : OneSided.Cfg Work (Label Q) :=
  ⟨.inl c.state, c.pos, c.cell⟩

theorem extend_run {Q : Type} (M : Machine Q Work) {c d : OneSided.Cfg Work Q}
    (h : StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step M) c d) :
    StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step (extend M)) (liftCfg c) (liftCfg d) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail a z _ h ih =>
    apply ih.tail
    change OneSided.step (extend M) (liftCfg a) = some (liftCfg z)
    have he : OneSided.step (extend M) (liftCfg a) =
        (OneSided.step M a).map liftCfg := by
      simp only [OneSided.step, liftCfg, extend]
      cases M.transition a.state (a.cell a.pos) <;> rfl
    rw [he, h]
    rfl

variable {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] {b : Nat}

abbrev stateCount (Q : Type) [Fintype Q] := OracleNegativePullback.states (Label Q)

noncomputable def code (q : Q) : Fin (stateCount Q + 3) := stateCode (Sum.inl q, false)
noncomputable def ctrl (c : Control) : Fin (stateCount Q + 3) := stateCode (Sum.inr c, false)
def boolLetter (v : Bool) : Letter := if v then 1 else 0

abbrev Instruction (s b : Nat) :=
  Sum (Fin (b + 4) → Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool) (Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3))

noncomputable def control (init : Q) (c : Control) : Instruction (stateCount Q) b :=
  match c with
  | .advance => .inl fun a => (ctrl .query, a, true)
  | .query => .inr (ctrl (.answer true), ctrl (.answer false))
  | .answer v => .inl fun a => (ctrl (.store v), a, false)
  | .store v => .inl fun _ => (code init, letterCode (boolLetter v), false)

noncomputable def oldProgram (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) : Program (stateCount Q) b :=
  program (extend M) (.inl stop) FoldLiteral.blank (symbolCode e)

noncomputable def tapeProgram (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) : Program (stateCount Q) b :=
  fun q =>
    if q = code stop then
      .inl fun a => if a = letterCode 2 then (ctrl .advance, a, true) else (1, a, false)
    else if h : ∃ c, q = ctrl (Q := Q) c then control M.initial h.choose
    else oldProgram M stop e q

theorem ctrl_inj : Function.Injective (ctrl (Q := Q)) := by
  intro c d h
  have hh := congrArg Prod.fst (stateCode_injective h)
  exact Sum.inr.inj hh

theorem ctrl_ne_code (c : Control) (q : Q) : ctrl (Q := Q) c ≠ code q := by
  intro h
  have hh : (Sum.inr c : Label Q) = Sum.inl q := congrArg Prod.fst (stateCode_injective h)
  cases hh

theorem tapeProgram_ctrl (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (c : Control) :
    tapeProgram M stop e (ctrl c) = control M.initial c := by
  have hc : ∃ d, ctrl (Q := Q) c = ctrl d := ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rw [tapeProgram, ite_eq_right (ctrl_ne_code c stop), dite_eq_left hc]
  rw [← ctrl_inj hc.choose_spec]

    oldProgram M stop e (ctrl c) = .inl (fun a => (2, a, false)) := by
  let : Nonempty (Label Q) := ⟨(extend M).initial⟩
  let : Nonempty Work := ⟨FoldLiteral.blank⟩
  simp [oldProgram, ctrl, program, extend,
    Function.leftInverse_invFun stateCode_injective (Sum.inr c, false)]

    {t u : Cfg (stateCount Q) b} (ht : step X (oldProgram M stop e) t u)
    (hu : halting (stateCount Q) u.1 = false) : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) t u := by

    (ht : wordOnTape w t)
    (hrun : StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step M)
      ⟨M.initial, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w⟩ ⟨stop, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w'⟩) :
    ∃ t', ReflTransGen (step X (tapeProgram M stop e))
      (code M.initial, 0, t) (code stop, 0, t') ∧ wordOnTape w' t' := by
  have hsim : simulates (symbolCode e) (liftCfg (⟨M.initial, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w⟩ :

    intro a

    (symbolCode e) X (symbolCode_injective e) hs hsim (extend_run M hrun)

  subst q j
  refine ⟨t', old_run_lift M stop e X hu (stateCode_nonhalting _), fun i => ?_⟩

    simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  unfold readNumeral at hread ⊢
  simpa only [List.drop_zero, hi, hd] using hread

def queryWord (v : Bool) (q : Nat) (payload : List Letter) : List Letter :=
  2 :: boolLetter v :: (out q ++ payload)

theorem wordOnTape_writeSame {w : List Letter} {t : List (Fin (b + 4))}
    (h : wordOnTape w t) (i : Nat) :
    wordOnTape w (write 2 t i (t.getD i 2)) :=
  fun j => (write_same _ _ _ _).trans (h j)

theorem wordOnTape_setAnswer {q : Nat} {payload : List Letter} {t : List (Fin (b + 4))}
    (h : wordOnTape (queryWord false q payload) t) (v : Bool) :
    wordOnTape (queryWord v q payload) (write 2 t 1 (letterCode (boolLetter v))) := by
  intro i
  rw [write_getD]
  rcases i with _ | _ | i
  · exact h 0
  · simp [queryWord]
  · exact h (i + 2)

theorem read_queryWord (e : Work ≃ Fin b) {v : Bool} {q : Nat} {payload : List Letter}
    {t : List (Fin (b + 4))} (h : wordOnTape (queryWord v q payload) t) :
    readNumeral b t 2 = some q := by
  have he : readNumeral b t 2 = readNumeral b (t.drop 2) 0 := by
    simp only [readNumeral, List.drop_zero]
  rw [he]
  apply read_delimited e
  intro i hi
  have hg : (t.drop 2).getD i 2 = t.getD (2 + i) 2 := by
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_drop]
  rw [hg, h]
  have hi' : i < ((out q).map (letterCode (b := b))).length := by
    simp [out]
    omega
  simp [queryWord, Nat.add_comm 2 i, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left hi']

theorem tape_accept (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat)
    (y : Nat) {t : List (Fin (b + 4))} (ht : wordOnTape (out y) t) :
    ∃ u, step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (code stop, 0, t) (1, 0, u) ∧
      readNumeral b u 0 = some y := by
  let u := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t 0 (t.getD 0 2)
  have hbit : t.getD 0 2 ≠ letterCode (2 : Letter) := by
    intro he
    have hd : t.getD 0 2 = 3 := he
    have hn : (bits y).length ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hempty : bits y = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h
      have hne := Nat.toDigits_ne_nil (b := 2) (n := y)
      apply hne
      simpa only [bits, List.map_eq_nil_iff] using hempty
    have h0 : 0 < ((bits y).map (letterCode (b := b))).length := by simpa using Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    have helem : t.getD 0 2 ∈ (bits y).map (letterCode (b := b)) := by
      rw [ht 0, out, List.map_append, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left h0,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem h0, Option.getD_some]
      exact List.getElem_mem _
    have hb := bits_no_delimiter b y _ helem
    simp only [hd, bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true] at hb
  refine ⟨u, ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at hbit
    simp [tapeProgram, hbit, u]
  · apply read_output e
    intro i
    exact (wordOnTape_writeSame ht 0 i).trans (raw_code e (out y) i).symm

theorem tape_query (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat)
    (q : Nat) (payload : List Letter) {t : List (Fin (b + 4))}
    (ht : wordOnTape (queryWord false q payload) t) :
    ∃ u v,
      step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (code stop, 0, t) u ∧
      ReflTransGen (step X (tapeProgram M stop e)) u (code M.initial, 0, v) ∧
      wordOnTape (queryWord (decide (q ∈ X)) q payload) v := by
  let bit := decide (q ∈ X)
  let t₀ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t 0 (t.getD 0 2)
  let t₁ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t₀ 1 (t₀.getD 1 2)
  let t₂ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t₁ 2 (t₁.getD 2 2)
  let t₃ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t₂ 1 (letterCode (boolLetter bit))
  have htag : t.getD 0 2 = letterCode (2 : Letter) := ht 0
  have h₀ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (code stop, 0, t) (ctrl .advance, 1, t₀) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at htag
    simp [tapeProgram, htag, t₀]
  have h₁ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl .advance, 1, t₀) (ctrl .query, 2, t₁) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, t₁]
  have ht₁ := wordOnTape_writeSame (wordOnTape_writeSame ht 0) 1
  have hr : readNumeral b t₁ 2 = some q := read_queryWord e ht₁
  have h₂ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl .query, 2, t₁) (ctrl (.answer bit), 2, t₁) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp only [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, hr]
    by_cases hx : q ∈ X
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, by simp [bit, hx]⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, by simp [bit, hx]⟩
  have h₃ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl (.answer bit), 2, t₁) (ctrl (.store bit), 1, t₂) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, t₂]
  have h₄ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl (.store bit), 1, t₂) (code M.initial, 0, t₃) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, t₃]
  exact ⟨_, _, h₀, (((ReflTransGen.single h₁).tail h₂).tail h₃).tail h₄,
    wordOnTape_setAnswer (wordOnTape_writeSame ht₁ 2) bit⟩

end SingletonTape

noncomputable def oraclePrefix (X : Set Nat) : Nat → List Bool
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 => oraclePrefix X n ++ [decide (n ∈ X)]

@[simp] theorem oraclePrefix_len (X : Set Nat) (k : Nat) : (oraclePrefix X k).length = k := by
  induction k <;> simp [oraclePrefix, *]

theorem oraclePrefix_agrees (X : Set Nat) (k : Nat) : agrees X (oraclePrefix X k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [agrees, oraclePrefix]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i v hv
    by_cases hl : i < k
    · rw [oraclePrefix, List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hl)] at hv
      exact ih i v hv
    · have he : k ≤ i := Nat.le_of_not_gt hl
      rw [oraclePrefix, List.getElem?_append_right (by simpa using he), oraclePrefix_len] at hv
      have hi : i = k := by
        by_contra hne
        rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega)] at hv
        cases hv
      subst i
      simp at hv
      rw [← hv]
      exact decide_eq_true_iff

theorem oraclePrefix_take (X : Set Nat) {k n : Nat} (h : k ≤ n) :
    (oraclePrefix X n).take k = oraclePrefix X k := by
  induction n with
  | zero => have : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h; simp [this, oraclePrefix]
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h with rfl | hl
    · apply List.take_of_length_le
      simp
    · have h' : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hl
      rw [oraclePrefix, List.take_append_of_le_length (by simpa using h')]
      exact ih h'

theorem findTest (X : Set Nat) {F : List Bool × Nat →. Nat} {f : Nat →. Nat}
    (hF : Partrec F) (ht : tracks X F f) :
    ∃ test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat, Computable test ∧
      ∀ n y, (∃ k, test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = some y) ↔ y ∈ f n := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.Partrec.Code.exists_code.mp hF
  have ceval (p : List Bool × Nat) : c.eval (Encodable.encode p) = F p := by
    rw [hc]
    simp [Encodable.encodek, Part.map_id']
  let test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat := fun p =>
    let kl := p.1.length.unpair
    Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln kl.2 c (Encodable.encode (p.1.take kl.1, p.2))
  have hkl : Primrec (fun p : List Bool × Nat => p.1.length.unpair) :=
    Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp Primrec.fst)
  have htake := Primrec.list_take.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hkl) (Primrec.fst : Primrec (@Prod.fst (List Bool) Nat))
  have hp := Primrec.encode.comp (htake.pair Primrec.snd)
  refine ⟨test, (Nat.Partrec.Code.primrec_evaln.comp
    (((Primrec.snd.comp hkl).pair (Primrec.const c)).pair hp)).to_comp, fun n y => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have h₁ : (Nat.unpair k).1 ≤ k := Nat.unpair_left_le k
    have hr : y ∈ F (oraclePrefix X (Nat.unpair k).1, n) := by
      rw [← ceval]
      apply Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln_sound
      have he := oraclePrefix_take X h₁
      simpa only [test, oraclePrefix_len, he, Option.mem_def] using hk
    exact ht.1 (oraclePrefix_agrees X _) hr
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ht.2 hy
    have hy' : y ∈ c.eval (Encodable.encode (oraclePrefix X k, n)) := by
      rw [ceval]
      exact hk _ (oraclePrefix_agrees X k) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln_complete.mp hy'
    refine ⟨Nat.pair k l, ?_⟩
    simpa only [test, oraclePrefix_len, Nat.unpair_pair, oraclePrefix_take X (Nat.left_le_pair k l),
      Option.mem_def] using hl

def packed (n : Nat) (w : List Bool) : List Letter :=
  bits (Nat.pair n (Encodable.encode w))

def stageWord (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (n : Nat) (w : List Bool) : List Letter :=
  match test (w, n) with
  | some y => out y
  | none => queryWord false w.length (packed n w)

def afterQuery (w : List Letter) : Nat × List Bool :=
  let p := (parse (((w.drop 2).dropWhile (· != 2)).drop 1)).unpair
  (p.1, (Encodable.decode (α := List Bool) p.2).getD [] ++ [w.getD 1 0 == 1])

def dispatch (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (w : List Letter) : List Letter :=
  if w.getD 0 0 == 2 then stageWord test (afterQuery w).1 (afterQuery w).2
  else stageWord test (parse w) []

theorem not_delim_bits (n : Nat) : ∀ l ∈ bits n, l != 2 := by
  intro l hl
  obtain ⟨d, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hl
  unfold ofChar
  split <;> decide

theorem bits_head_not_delim (n : Nat) : (bits n).getD 0 0 ≠ 2 := by
  cases hk : (bits n)[0]? with
  | none => simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hk]
  | some l =>
    have hl := not_delim_bits n l (List.mem_of_getElem? hk)
    simpa [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hk] using hl

theorem dispatch_initial (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (n : Nat) :
    dispatch test (bits n) = stageWord test n [] := by
  have h := bits_head_not_delim n
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at h
  simp [dispatch, h, parse_bits]

theorem dispatch_afterQuery (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (v : Bool) (q n : Nat)
    (w : List Bool) :
    dispatch test (queryWord v q (packed n w)) = stageWord test n (w ++ [v]) := by
  unfold dispatch afterQuery queryWord
  have hv : (boolLetter v == 1) = v := by cases v <;> rfl
  simp [out, List.append_assoc, List.dropWhile_append_of_pos (not_delim_bits q),
    packed, parse_bits, Encodable.encodek, hv]

theorem comp_dispatch (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (ht : Computable test) :
    Computable (dispatch test) := by
  open Primrec in
  have pparse : Primrec parse := by
    have digit : Primrec (fun p : Nat × Letter => 2 * p.1 + p.2.val) :=
      nat_add.comp (nat_mul.comp (const 2) fst) (fin_val.comp snd)
    exact list_foldl Primrec.id (const 0) (digit.comp snd).to₂
  open Primrec in
  have pout : Primrec out := list_append.comp prim_bits (const [2])
  open Primrec in
  have pPacked : Primrec (fun p : Nat × List Bool => packed p.1 p.2) :=
    prim_bits.comp (Primrec₂.natPair.comp fst (Primrec.encode.comp snd))
  open Primrec in
  have pQuery : Primrec (fun p : List Bool × Nat =>
      queryWord false p.1.length (packed p.2 p.1)) :=
    list_cons.comp (const 2) (list_cons.comp (const (boolLetter false))
      (list_append.comp (pout.comp (list_length.comp fst)) (pPacked.comp (snd.pair fst))))
  have hStage : Computable (fun p : List Bool × Nat => stageWord test p.2 p.1) := by
    apply (Computable.option_casesOn ht pQuery.to_comp (pout.to_comp.comp Computable.snd).to₂).of_eq
    intro p
    unfold stageWord
    cases test p <;> rfl
  open Primrec in
  have pAfter : Primrec afterQuery := by
    have he : Primrec (fun w : List Letter =>
        (parse (((w.drop 2).dropWhile (· != 2)).drop 1)).unpair) :=
      unpair.comp (pparse.comp (list_drop.comp (const 1)
        ((list_dropWhile (Primrec.not.comp (Primrec.beq.comp Primrec.id (const 2)))).comp
          (list_drop.comp (const 2) Primrec.id))))
    have hbit : Primrec (fun w : List Letter => w.getD 1 0 == 1) :=
      Primrec.beq.comp (list_getD 0 |>.comp Primrec.id (const 1)) (const 1)
    exact (fst.comp he).pair (list_append.comp
      (option_getD.comp (Primrec.decode.comp (snd.comp he)) (const []))
      (list_cons.comp hbit (const [])))
  have hp : Primrec (fun w : List Letter => w.getD 0 0 == 2) :=
    Primrec.beq.comp (Primrec.list_getD 0 |>.comp Primrec.id (Primrec.const 0)) (Primrec.const 2)
  apply (Computable.cond hp.to_comp
    (hStage.comp ((Primrec.snd.comp pAfter).pair (Primrec.fst.comp pAfter)).to_comp)
    (hStage.comp ((Primrec.const []).pair pparse).to_comp)).of_eq
  intro w
  unfold dispatch
  cases w.getD 0 0 == 2 <;> rfl

end SingletonTape

theorem no_terminal_of_progress {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop}
    (hu : Relator.RightUnique r) {ready : α → Prop}
    (ha : ∀ a, ready a → ∃ b, TransGen r a b ∧ ready b) {a t : α}
    (hready : ready a) (hr : ReflTransGen r a t) : ∃ v, r t v := by
  let live (s : α) : Prop := ∃ z, TransGen r s z ∧ ready z
  have forward {s u : α} (h : r s u) (hs : live s) : live u := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hreadyz⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvz⟩ := TransGen.head'_iff.mp hz
    obtain rfl := hu h hv
    rcases reflTransGen_iff_eq_or_transGen.mp hvz with rfl | h'
    · exact ha _ hreadyz
    · exact ⟨z, h', hreadyz⟩
  have ht : live t := by
    induction hr with
    | refl => exact ha _ hready
    | tail _ h ih => exact forward h ih
  obtain ⟨_, hz, _⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _⟩ := TransGen.head'_iff.mp hz
  exact ⟨v, hv⟩

noncomputable def entryWord (X : Set Nat) (n : Nat) : Nat → List Letter
  | 0 => bits n
  | k + 1 => queryWord (decide (k ∈ X)) k (packed n (oraclePrefix X k))

theorem dispatch_entry (X : Set Nat) (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (n k : Nat) :
    dispatch test (entryWord X n k) = stageWord test n (oraclePrefix X k) := by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact dispatch_initial test n
  | succ k => exact dispatch_afterQuery test (decide (k ∈ X)) k n (oraclePrefix X k)

theorem compileTest (X : Set Nat) (f : Nat →. Nat) (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat)
    (hc : Computable test)
    (htest : ∀ n y, (∃ k, test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = some y) ↔ y ∈ f n) :
    ∃ (s b : Nat) (p : Program s b), ∀ n,
      (haltsWith X p n (fun q _ => q = 1) ↔ (f n).Dom) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ f n, haltsWith X p n (fun _ t => readNumeral b t 0 = some y)) := by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, iΛ, M₀, first, last, hs, hEval₀⟩ :=
    WordEvaluator.exists_safe_tape (comp_dispatch test hc).partrec
  let : Fintype Λ := hΛ
  let : Inhabited Λ := iΛ
  let M := FoldLiteral.wrapper M₀ first
  let stop : FoldLiteral.State Λ := some none
  let Q := FoldLiteral.State Λ
  let e := Fintype.equivFin Work
  let b := Fintype.card Work
  let s := stateCount Q
  let p := tapeProgram M stop e
  let r := step X p
  have hstop : ∀ a, M.transition stop a = none := fun _ => rfl
  have hEval (w : List Letter) : StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step M)
      ⟨M.initial, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w⟩ ⟨stop, 0, FoldLiteral.raw (dispatch test w)⟩ := by
    apply (StateTransition.mem_eval.mp ?_).1
    change FoldLiteral.final (dispatch test w) ∈
      StateTransition.eval (OneSided.step M) (FoldLiteral.initial w)
    rw [FoldLiteral.wrapper_eval M₀ first last hs hEval₀]
    exact Part.mem_map _ (Part.mem_some _)
  refine ⟨s, b, p, fun n => ?_⟩
  let boot : Cfg s b := (0, 0, numeral b n)
  let QInit := code M.initial
  let QStop := code stop
  let entry := entryWord X n
  let check := fun k => test (oraclePrefix X k, n)
  have hzero : ∃ t, r boot (QInit, 0, t) ∧ wordOnTape (entry 0) t :=
    tape_boot M stop e X n
  have transform {k : Nat} {t : List (Fin (b+4))} (ht : wordOnTape (entry k) t) :
      ∃ t', ReflTransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (QStop, 0, t') ∧
        wordOnTape (stageWord test n (oraclePrefix X k)) t' := by
    obtain ⟨t', hreach, hout⟩ := tape_run M stop e X hstop ht (hEval (entry k))
    refine ⟨t', hreach, ?_⟩
    rw [dispatch_entry] at hout
    exact hout
  have advance {k : Nat} {t : List (Fin (b+4))} (ht : wordOnTape (entry k) t)
      (hk : check k = none) :
      ∃ t', TransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (QInit, 0, t') ∧ wordOnTape (entry (k+1)) t' := by
    obtain ⟨t', hr, hout⟩ := transform ht
    have ho : wordOnTape (queryWord false k (packed n (oraclePrefix X k))) t' := by
      simpa only [stageWord, show test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = none from hk, oraclePrefix_len]
        using hout
    obtain ⟨_, u, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := tape_query M stop e X k _ ho
    exact ⟨u, (TransGen.tail' hr h₁).trans_left h₂, h₃⟩
  have accept {k y : Nat} {t : List (Fin (b+4))} (ht : wordOnTape (entry k) t)
      (hk : check k = some y) :
      ∃ t', ReflTransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (1, 0, t') ∧ readNumeral b t' 0 = some y := by
    obtain ⟨t', hr, hout⟩ := transform ht
    have ho : wordOnTape (out y) t' := by
      simpa only [stageWord, show test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = some y from hk] using hout
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hy⟩ := tape_accept M stop e X y ho
    exact ⟨u, hr.tail hu, hy⟩
  have reach (k : Nat) (hk : ∀ i < k, check i = none) :
      ∃ t, ReflTransGen r boot (QInit, 0, t) ∧ wordOnTape (entry k) t := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hw⟩ := hzero
      exact ⟨t, .single ht, hw⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hw⟩ := ih (fun i hi => hk i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi))
      obtain ⟨t', hr, hw'⟩ := advance hw (hk k (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
      exact ⟨t', ht.trans hr.to_reflTransGen, hw'⟩
  have outcome (y : Nat) (hy : y ∈ f n) :
      ∃ t, ReflTransGen r boot (1, 0, t) ∧ readNumeral b t 0 = some y := by
    have hex : ∃ k, check k = some y := (htest n y).mpr hy
    let k := Nat.find hex
    have earlier (i : Nat) (hi : i < k) : check i = none := by
      cases he : check i with
      | none => rfl
      | some z =>
        have hzy := Part.mem_unique ((htest n z).mp ⟨i, he⟩) hy
        subst z
        exact (Nat.find_min hex hi he).elim
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hw⟩ := reach k earlier
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hread⟩ := accept hw (Nat.find_spec hex)
    exact ⟨u, ht.trans hu, hread⟩
  have acceptsOnly (hh : haltsWith X p n (fun q _ => q = 1)) : (f n).Dom := by
    by_contra hd
    have allNone (k : Nat) : check k = none := by
      cases he : check k with
      | none => rfl
      | some y => exact (hd ((htest n y).mp ⟨k, he⟩).fst).elim
    let ready (a : Cfg s b) : Prop := ∃ k t, a = (QInit, 0, t) ∧ wordOnTape (entry k) t
    have progress (a : Cfg s b) (ha : ready a) : ∃ t, TransGen r a t ∧ ready t := by
      obtain ⟨k, t, rfl, hw⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hw'⟩ := advance hw (allNone k)
      exact ⟨_, hu, k+1, u, rfl, hw'⟩
    obtain ⟨t, hb, hw⟩ := hzero
    obtain ⟨q, j, tape, hrun, hhalt, _⟩ := hh
    have ht := no_terminal_of_progress (step_unique X p) progress
      (show ready (QInit, 0, t) from ⟨0, t, rfl, hw⟩)
      (show ReflTransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (q, j, tape) from by
        rcases ReflTransGen.cases_head hrun with he | ⟨u, hu, htail⟩
        · have hq := congrArg Prod.fst he
          have he' : q = 0 := hq.symm
          rw [he'] at hhalt
          change false = true at hhalt
          contradiction
        · have h := step_unique X p hb hu
          rw [h]
          exact htail)
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ht
    exact Bool.noConfusion (hhalt.symm.trans hv.1)
  have hhalt : halting s (1 : Fin (s+3)) = true := by simp [halting]
  refine ⟨⟨acceptsOnly, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := outcome _ (Part.get_mem hd)
    exact ⟨1, 0, t, ht, hhalt, rfl⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hr⟩ := outcome y hy
    exact ⟨1, 0, t, ht, hhalt, hr⟩
